[[File:Fall.png|150px|class=pixels]]
'''Fall''' is the third [[seasons|season]] players play through. It is followed by [[Winter]] and preceded by [[Summer]]. Some of the most valuable [[crops]] can grow during Fall. During this season the leaves of some trees change color, and [[Trees|Mushroom Trees]] can appear on the Farm. __TOC__ ==Events== {{Calendar|fall}} {| |- |style="vertical-align: top;"| ===Festivals=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Day !Name |- |16||
